notes.title: Rules of Destruction Update
notes.content:
See what`s new in Rules of Destruction!
[list]
    [*]Small part of Astrila Revealed 
    [*]Improved Combat system with combo attacks, and new animations
    [*]Absolutely new movement animator controller
    [*]Added skill tab 
    [*]Added fishing
    [*]Fixed problems, with auto attacks and hunger
[/list]
